args.title: No authorized payment route; founder picks Apify (A) or a Gumroad seller account (B)
args.detail: Updated 2026-11-07. commercial_paths.collection is NOT_IMPLEMENTED and the treasury is UNFUNDED. There is now a concrete candidate for option B: products/sites/supplier-shopify-diff (an offline browser tool that compares a supplier CSV with a Shopify CSV; 17/17 synthetic tests including Python parity at 10000 rows; dry_run digest 241dc433...). An independent review is pending. Browser execution and real Shopify imports are untested. The problem evidence comes from forum replies in Shopify Community thread 683136 (at least 5 participants compare these files by hand in Excel). That is stated interest, not purchases, and a free competitor was reported. USD 19 one-time is an unvalidated hypothesis (products/services/supplier-shopify-diff/gumroad-package-notes.md). Option B, the smallest founder step: create or designate a GlobalLand Gumroad seller account in the founder's name with CAD bank payouts (Stripe KYC; USD 100 minimum payout; 10%+$0.50 fee on direct sales) and share only its public profile URL. Agents then prepare the package for independent review and the founder uploads it. Option A is unchanged: an Apify config plus a 0600 credential (NO-APIFY-ACCESS) unlocks 3 tested Actors. Agents will not create accounts, accept terms or take orders.
